mapper.select: SELECT ts.id, ts.step_instance_id AS stepInstanceId, ts.enqueue_seq AS enqueueSeq, t.queue_id AS queueId, t.priority AS priority FROM task_step ts JOIN task t ON t.id = ts.task_id WHERE ts.status = 'WAITING_RESOURCE' AND t.deleted = false ORDER BY ts.enqueue_seq LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ts.id, ts.step_instance_id AS stepInstanceId, ts.mutex_group AS mutexGroup, ts.dispatch_token AS dispatchToken, ts.enqueue_seq AS enqueueSeq, t.queue_id AS queueId, t.priority AS priority, t.task_id AS taskId FROM task_step ts JOIN task t ON t.id = ts.task_id WHERE ts.mutex_holder = true AND ts.status = 'RUNNING' AND t.deleted = false LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ts.id, ts.step_instance_id AS stepInstanceId, n.id AS nodeId, ts.resource_request AS resourceRequest FROM task_step ts JOIN executor_node n ON n.ip = ts.machine_ip AND n.cluster_id = ts.cluster_id WHERE ts.status IN ('SCHEDULING', 'RUNNING') AND ts.machine_ip IS NOT NULL LIMIT #{limit}
